title: WalletCardTopupFailed
description: A top-up from a card did not go through; nothing was charged.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

org_id.description: The organization whose wallet it is.

amount.description: The sum of the top-up, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

auto.description: Started by the wallet's automatic top-up, not by the person.

card_brand.description: The network of the card that paid; null when the card is gone.

card_last4.description: Its last four digits; null when the card is gone.
